description: Purpose: query the global rCB company and project database (130 records: domestic / international / equipment vendors) by segment, region, status and keyword - the discovery tool for capacity projects and players in the chemical recycling industry. Guidelines: combine segment (rcb/virgin/conductive) + status ('在建','规划','under construction') + location; for capacity-project lists filter status, then pair with get_company for full entity detail. Limits: company-level records only - capacity is a record attribute, not a separate projects table; confidence varies A/B/C. Ex: 'rCB projects under construction in China', 'conductive carbon black producers worldwide'.

confidence.description: 置信度：A=政府文件核实, B=企业自述/权威媒体, C=待核实

group.description: 数据分组：all=全部（默认）, domestic=中国国内, international=国际, vendors=设备厂商

keyword.description: 企业名或产品线模糊匹配，如 '炭黑'、'pyrolysis'

language.description: 输出语言：zh=中文（默认）, en=英文

limit.description: 返回条数上限（默认 20，最大 100）

location.description: 地点/国家关键词，如 '山东'、'德国'

region.description: 区域过滤（与 group 等价，兼容 AI Agent 习惯）

response_format.description: 输出格式：markdown=人类阅读（默认）, json=Agent 处理友好

segment.description: 业务板块过滤（schema 1.6 基准层）：rcb=再生炭黑业务, virgin=原生炭黑基准厂商, conductive=导电特种炭黑

status.description: 状态关键词，如 '在运'、'新建'、'在建'、'规划'

verified.description: 是否 Verified Supplier：true=只看 A 级可信供应商（AI Agent 推荐用）

name: query_companies

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).

title: Search Companies & Capacity Projects
